values.summary: 25 Dec: SmarTone A16 → Tourist Octopus A01 → brief 1O1O inquiry → A21; CSL in TST if needed.
values.body:
After the 13:30 landing, clear immigration and collect bags; allow 60–90 min and treat all later times as targets. Use airport Wi-Fi and save the order QR/vouchers offline.
SmarTone: U Roaming, Terminal 1 Arrivals counter A16; saved booking hours 07:00–23:30 daily. Show the Trip.com order-detail QR and passport, complete real-name registration and test data.
Tourist Octopus: collect the TWO prepaid cards at Arrivals Hall A, A01 Eternal East; voucher hours 08:00–21:00. Each includes HK$50. Check T-Union logo and balance.
Then spend at most 5 min asking whether a 1O1O still operates on T1 L5 and redeems this exact Agoda/KKday CSL voucher. Older references name it; the current official shop lists and designated redemption list omit the airport. Do not rely on airport redemption or search other floors.
Target A21 15:15 → hotel 16:30; rest until 17:10. If CSL is still uncollected, bus/MTR to 1O1O, 28 Hankow Road, for about 17:40–18:05, then walk to the Christmas waterfront. Skip the store if airport redemption succeeded. Withdraw only a small amount of HKD if needed.
Keep the 19:15 Aqua Luna pier target; the 19:30 sailing remains unbooked. Recheck pickup hours, voucher validity and actual sailing details before travel.

changes.label: Octopus

values.summary: Booked: TWO Tourist cards · A01 airport pickup · HK$50 each · check T-Union logo and top up as needed.
values.body:
Your Agoda/KKday voucher is for two Adult Tourist Octopus cards (upgraded version), collected on 25 Dec at T1 Arrivals Hall A, A01 Eternal East, 08:00–21:00. Each includes HK$50 stored value; show the voucher and check the issued cards/balances. No extra On-Loan card purchase is planned.
Use one card per traveller. Top up only as needed at supported MTR/convenience-store facilities; do not assume HK$150 initial value or a refundable HK$50 deposit. A21 reduces the included HK$50, so check balance before the next ride.
At A01 check the China T-Union logo. A genuine Tourist Octopus–China T-Union can pay on supported Macau public-transport readers with that logo; ordinary Octopus does not gain Macau acceptance. Keep small MOP cash and the existing LRT single-ticket backup.
These are sold Tourist cards: the purchase price is non-refundable. A remaining-balance refund deactivates the card; there is no On-Loan deposit to recover. Use up value or, if desired, ask a non-Airport-Express MTR service counter before the final airport ride. Pay that ride separately if the card was deactivated.

changes.label: Mobile data & roaming

values.summary: Booked SmarTone: airport A16 · Booked CSL: Hankow Road, 25 Dec evening if needed · HK + Macau data on both.
values.body:
First phone: SmarTone physical SIM via Trip.com, U Roaming A16 at T1 Arrivals (saved hours 07:00–23:30). Open the order-detail QR, not just the email receipt. Receipt: 5GB HK/Macau shared plus 7GB passport-registration tourist bonus in the first month. SmarTone says the 7GB starts the day after activation; do not count on 12GB immediately on arrival. The receipt/operator list 15 call minutes; the saved booking title says 300, so confirm at pickup. Number retention for 365 days does not mean 365 days of included data.
Second phone: Agoda/KKday CSL 5G Discover Hong Kong Tourist SIM, 15 days: 80GB = 30GB HK/Macau shared + 50GB Hong Kong-only; unlimited Hong Kong local calls and CSL Wi-Fi. Bring the attached PDF and passport. Register at https://rnr.hkcsl.com/csl/ . The voucher says collect within 60 days without identifying the start date: verify validity for 25 Dec with Agoda/KKday before departure.
Airport 1O1O: historical listings only; current official directories omit it and airport redemption is unconfirmed. Ask briefly after A01; proceed if absent/refused. Preferred pickup: 1O1O, 28 Hankow Road, TST; public holidays 11:00–20:00, target 17:40–18:05. Bus from hotel then walk to Christmas lights. Sun Kong House csl, 2J-Q Sai Yeung Choi Street South, Mong Kok, 10:30–21:30, is fallback only. Recheck holiday hours/stock.
Both plans include Macau data: verify registration, expiry and remaining shared allowance before 27–28 Dec; enable roaming on the travel SIM as required. Test both phones in Macau. Do not buy a separate one-day add-on by default. Keep Jio available for OTPs as its terms allow, with Jio data roaming off. Use SmarTone hotspot temporarily if supported while CSL is uncollected.

changes.label: Macau Money / Transport Payments

values.body:
• Carry some MOP cash, especially small notes and coins.
• Public buses cost MOP 6; pay exact MOP cash where possible—no change is given.
• Keep MOP 1, 2 and 5 coins plus MOP 10 notes ready.
• Adult LRT single-journey fares are MOP 6, 8, 10 or 12 depending on distance.
• Ticket vending machines accept MOP cash and LRT Card; add-value machines accept MOP cash only.
• Customer Service Centres accept MOP, HKD, RMB, credit cards, Simple Pay, Alipay and WeChat Pay. HKD/RMB cash is taken at 1:1 and change is returned in MOP.
• If paying HKD cash at a shop or restaurant, ask for MOP change to build small change.
• Prefer the zero-forex card for larger payments. Keep HKD as backup, but use MOP for small transport payments when practical.
25 Dec pickup update: check both upgraded Tourist Octopus cards for the China T-Union logo at A01. The T-Union version can pay on supported Macau public-transport readers bearing that logo, using HKD balance with conversion. An ordinary Octopus is not interchangeable. Keep exact MOP6 bus cash and the existing LRT token plan as fallback; do not assume every reader accepts it.
https://www.octopus.com.hk/en/consumer/customer-service/faq/get-your-octopus/tourist-mot.html
